svg.title: noderaven: a year of contributions surveyed as terrain
svg.desc: Topographic map of 3,059 GitHub contributions from 23 Nov 2025 to 28 Nov 2026. Each day is a survey point; busy days rise into hills. 8 on 12 Mar 2026, 109 on 24 Jun 2026, 158 on 15 Oct 2026, 132 on 9 Nov 2026.
svg.text: A year of commits, surveyed as terrain
I harden identity, Microsoft 365 and endpoints, study how
systems break, and build the tools that come out of it.
3,059 contributions, 23 Nov 2025 to 28 Nov 2026. Surveyed 28 Nov 2026 by GitHub Actions.

g.text: Contours rise with each day’s commits
